title: Zenith deploy cadence calendar and release digest (Jun 2026) - draft
content:
OVERVIEW:
This doc captures the proposed "Zenith" deployment cadence for the upcoming platform patch (mid-June window). Intent is to reduce noisy mid-rollout regressions by running a short, traffic-weighted ramp with fixed observation pauses and small-batch hotfix lanes. Draft of release notes included at the bottom; treat as customer-facing copy candidate.

GOALS:
- Get patch to prod with minimal latency regressions and no user-facing errors.
- Keep rollback surface small and predictable.
- Validate caching/KV-warm paths under normal user mix.
- Capture post-deploy telemetry in a compact digest for product and SRE.

ROLLOUT CALENDAR (Zenith window):
- T+0 (2026-06-14 02:00 UTC) - Preflight + config pin; brief on #deploy-ops (5m).
- T+10m (02:10 UTC) - Canary batch A: 0.5% traffic -> 10m steady observation. (owner: Liam)
- T+30m (02:30 UTC) - Batch B: 3% traffic -> 20m observation, smoke checks. (owner: Maya)
- T+1h15m (03:15 UTC) - Batch C: 12% traffic -> 30m observation, slow query profiles. (owner: Jordan)
- T+2h (04:00 UTC) - Zenith step: 50% traffic -> 40m observation, KV warm assertions. (owner: Sofia)
- T+3h (05:00 UTC) - Full (100%) cutover if metrics green -> 30m stabilization watch. (owner: on-call)

NOTE: each observation pause includes an automatic 10m anomaly cooldown (if thresholds tripped, pause further ramps and evaluate).

PREFLIGHT CHECKLIST (quick):
- [ ] Confirm rollback image exists and has been smoke-tested (PR 3412).
- [ ] Verify DB migration is NOT in this patch (NO schema changes).
- [ ] Confirm autoscaling policies unchanged for the window.
- [ ] Validate pipeline artifacts uploaded to s3://releases/zenith/2026-06-14.
- [ ] Run short loadscript (zz-small) against staging for 20m and collect latency p95/p99.
- [ ] Notify product & support: 48h and 1h reminders (Slack + email).
- [ ] Reconfirm on-call rotation for the night of: names + escalation tree.

DEPLOY STEPS (operators):
- Step 0: Lock feature flags for dependent experiments (FF keys listed below).
- Step 1: Deploy: version tag v2026.6.14-zenith to staging -> smoke.
- Step 2: Promote canary image to region-edge pool (small subset).
- Step 3: Sequential traffic-weighted steps as per calendar above.
- Step 4: Run KV prefix-warm job after hitting 12% traffic; check hit-rate delta.
- Step 5: If any step trips rollback trigger, run rollback script and open incident channel.

ROLLBACK TRIGGERS (explicit):
- Error rate: >= 1.0% user-facing 5xx over 5m and sustained for 2 windows.
- Latency: p99 increase > 250ms versus baseline for >10m.
- Regression in correctness signals: reranker score drift >3% on smoke prompt set.
- Autoscaling exhaustion: any region hitting 90% GPU mem and sustained throttling.

ROLLBACK STEPS (fast):
- 1) Pause ramping and set traffic to previous stable tag (v2026.6.13).
- 2) Re-enable safety throttle: 10rps per-host limit.
- 3) Open incident in #incidents/launch with incident lead assigned.
- 4) Run capture script and attach traces to JIRA ticket.

OBSERVABILITY SIGNALS (primary):
- 5xx rate (gateway + model proxy).
- p95/p99 latency for generation path and embedding path (separate).
- KV cache hit-rate and prefix latency.
- Rerank & hallucination proxy metric (internal eval harness).
- Cost per token delta (to spot accidental token inflation).

SAMPLE DASHBOARD PANELS TO WATCH:
- "Zenith: user-5xx-over-time" (3m resolution)
- "Model p99 vs baseline" (rolling 30m)
- "KV hit-rate by prefix"
- "Batching efficiency: avg batch size"

COMMUNICATION PLAN:
- Pre-launch: 48h & 1h reminders in #deploy-ops; send short note to product and support with expected user impact.
- During: use thread on #deploy-ops, DM incident lead for escalations.
- Post-deploy: short summary in #deploy-ops and a release digest to product and exec (one-paragraph).
- Pager escalation: SRE -> Eng TL -> IR lead.

RELEASE NOTES DRAFT (customer-facing candidate):
Title: "June 2026 platform release - efficiency and stability improvements"
Summary: "This update includes runtime routing improvements, a smaller memory leak fix in the KV cache layer, and efficiency tweaks to our batching logic resulting in lower tail latencies for generation requests. No schema or customer data migrations are included in this release."
What's improved:
- "Reduced generation p99 by ~15-30ms for common request shapes."
- "Fixed intermittent KV cache leak causing high mem in edge pods."
- "Improved routing logic to favor lower-latency model variants for small-batch requests."
Known issues:
- "A small subset of internal rerank tests show a subtle score drift in edge cases (tracked under JIRA-1078). This does not impact normal chat or embedding flows."

INTERNAL RELEASE NOTES (technical):
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3412 - core batching kernel tweak.
- JIRA-1024 - KV cache leak fix (merged).
- JIRA-1078 - rerank score investigation (monitoring only in this patch).
- Runtime images: v2026.6.14-zenith (primary), rollback tag v2026.6.13.

POST-DEPLOY DIGEST TEMPLATE (to populate after):
- Window: UTC timestamps for each step.
- Main signals snapshot: p99, 5xx rate, KV hit-rate diff, avg batch size pre/post.
- Actions taken: any hotfixes, rollbacks, or config tweaks.
- Owner notes (quick bullets).

OPEN QUESTIONS / NOTES TO SELF:
- Do we want to gate on rerank-sanity automatically or keep manual (currently manual - pros/cons listed below).
- Consider adding a short synthetic load against edge region at each ramp step (cost tradeoffs).
- Check with infra: is the 50% Zenith step safe for region-privacy tenants? (Priya to confirm with account team).

APPENDIX: quick commands and links
- rollback script: github.com/redwood-inference/platform/scripts/rollback.sh (operator-only)
- smoke job: infra/ci/zz-small-runner (staging)
- Slack: #deploy-ops, #incidents/launch, #sre-oncall

TODO (before T-0):
- [ ] Maya: confirm release artifact location and checksum.
- [ ] Liam: run warm-kv job on staging and send snapshot.
- [ ] Priya: confirm account privacy caveats for Zenith 50% step.
- [ ] Jordan: prepare short post-deploy digest template in Confluence.

-- End draft --
(Notes: this is intentionally compact; will expand the observability playbook if we run a rehearsal next week)
